thought.text: The apps are using workspaces from `WEB-INF/conf` (inside the WAR) instead of `/opt/deegree`. The `DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT` isn't being picked up. Let me check what the app sees:

reasoning_content:
The WFS war doesn't have a WEB-INF/conf directory, so deegree's DefaultWorkspace is being used. It looks for a workspace at the path `DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT/workspaceName` based on the `webapp.properties` file in the deegree workspace root, but it's actually using a default external workspace at `/opt/tomcat-dienste/webapps/xplan-services-wfs/WEB-INF/conf`. Since there's no webapp.properties in WEB-INF/conf, deegree can't determine which workspace to use.

The guide specifies that webapp.properties should be placed under `<DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT>`, and I've already put it there at /opt/deegree/webapp.properties. But deegree's workspace lookup is still falling back to the WEB-INF/conf location. This might be because DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT isn't being recognized, or because deegree 3.6 changed how it resolves the workspace.

The log shows "Using workspace 'default(external)' at '/opt/tomcat-dienste/webapps/xplan-services-wfs/WEB-INF/conf'", which means DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT is being ignored and it's defaulting to WEB-INF/conf. The issue is likely that the system property `-DDEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT=/opt/deegree` isn't taking effect because catalina.sh is overriding it, or because deegree's DefaultWorkspace doesn't actually use that property in this version. I need to check the actual deegree documentation to see how the workspace root is determined in version 3.5/3.6.

Looking at the log line "Using workspace 'default(external)' at '/opt/tomcat-dienste/webapps/xplan-services-wfs/WEB-INF/conf'" — it's defaulting to WEB-INF/conf as a relative path. This suggests DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT isn't being picked up. I'm checking whether the webapp.properties file is in the right location and whether the context name is being resolved correctly. The webapp.properties maps "/xplan-services-wfs=xplan-services-wfs-workspace", so with context name "/xplan-services-wfs" it should find the workspace at /opt/deegree/xplan-services-wfs-workspace. But the fact that it's not working means either DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT isn't set or webapp.properties isn't being found. I need to check the system properties in the Tomcat logs to see what's actually configured, and also look at how the docker kubectl deployment sets this up — it might be setting DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT as an environment variable rather than a Java system property.

Now I'm wondering if the issue is that DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT is set in setenv.sh but the catalina environment isn't exporting it properly, or if the deegree property name is actually different in this version.

Let me check the Tomcat logs to see what system properties are being set at startup and whether DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT is actually being recognized by the application.

action.command: grep -iE "DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT|workspace root|Using workspace|external" /opt/tomcat-dienste/logs/catalina.out | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -ivE "JDBC|Driver" | tail -12
